{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go",
      "line": 189,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "concurrency",
      "title": "Unsynchronized shared writes in search init workers",
      "body": "searchSupport.init starts multiple errgroup workers that all increment totalBatchesIndexed and assign to the outer err variable. These are shared variables with no mutex, atomic, or local handling, so concurrent index builds race. The reported indexed count can be wrong, an error can be overwritten, and the Go race detector will fail."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go",
      "line": 72,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "concurrency",
      "title": "BuildIndex can run concurrently for the same namespaced resource",
      "body": "The patch removes the global lock around BuildIndex but adds no per-key synchronization or singleflight. GetIndex returns nil until BuildIndex inserts the finished index, so concurrent Search or watch-event calls for the same namespace/group/resource can both start builds. This duplicates work, can open the same file-backed bleve directory concurrently, and lets the last writer replace another live index in the cache without closing it. Add a per-key lock or reserve the key while building."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go",
      "line": 146,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "concurrency",
      "title": "TotalDocs iterates the index cache without locking",
      "body": "bleveBackend.TotalDocs ranges over b.cache while BuildIndex may concurrently write to that map. TotalDocs does not take cacheMu.RLock, so this is an unsynchronized map read/write that can panic or return wrong totals. This is more likely now that BuildIndex only locks for the cache insertion."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go",
      "line": 925,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "History and Origin dereference s.search without nil checks",
      "body": "server.History calls s.search.History and server.Origin calls s.search.Origin, but s.search can be nil when search is not configured. server.Search checks for this case, while History and Origin will panic on a nil pointer if invoked. Add nil checks or return a not-configured error."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go",
      "line": 209,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Watch loop does not handle closed event channel",
      "body": "The goroutine started in searchSupport.init receives from events with v := <-events and passes v to handleEvent. If the storage backend closes the channel, the receive returns a nil *WrittenEvent repeatedly, and handleEvent dereferences evt.Type, causing a panic. The loop also has no context.Done branch, so it cannot be stopped cleanly. Use v, ok := <-events and stop when !ok, and select on a cancellable context."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go",
      "line": 263,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "IndexMetrics is used without nil checks in handleEvent",
      "body": "handleEvent increments and decrements IndexMetrics.IndexedKinds for added and deleted events without checking whether IndexMetrics is nil. Other parts of the code guard with if IndexMetrics != nil. If metrics are not initialized, any ADDED or DELETED watch event will panic."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go",
      "line": 102,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "BuildIndex uses IndexMetrics without nil check",
      "body": "BuildIndex increments resource.IndexMetrics.IndexTenants unconditionally. Since other code paths check whether IndexMetrics is nil, this can panic when metrics are disabled or uninitialized. Guard the metric calls or guarantee initialization."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go",
      "line": 258,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Constructor leaks context/lifecycle resources when Init fails",
      "body": "NewResourceServer creates a cancellable context and may run lifecycle initialization before s.Init. If s.Init returns an error, the constructor returns without calling cancel or stopping lifecycle hooks, leaking the context and any initialized backend resources. Clean up on the error path."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go",
      "line": 203,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "data",
      "title": "Initial index build can miss events written before the watch starts",
      "body": "searchSupport.init builds all indexes first and only then calls WatchWriteEvents. Writes that happen while the initial build is running are not included in the built index and are not replayed by the watcher, which starts after the build. In deployments with concurrent writers or other instances, the search index can remain stale until affected resources are written again."
    },
    {
      "file": "pkg/server/module_server_test.go",
      "line": 36,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "test_gap",
      "title": "Postgres storage-server integration test is skipped",
      "body": "The test now skips for GRAFANA_TEST_DB=postgres, so the storage server startup path is not exercised against Postgres in CI. Since this PR changes initialization timing and index building, this reduces coverage for a supported database; the skip should be tied to a tracked fix rather than left as an indefinite TODO."
    }
  ]
}

findings.title: Unsynchronized shared writes in search init workers
findings.body: searchSupport.init starts multiple errgroup workers that all increment totalBatchesIndexed and assign to the outer err variable. These are shared variables with no mutex, atomic, or local handling, so concurrent index builds race. The reported indexed count can be wrong, an error can be overwritten, and the Go race detector will fail.

findings.title: BuildIndex can run concurrently for the same namespaced resource
findings.body: The patch removes the global lock around BuildIndex but adds no per-key synchronization or singleflight. GetIndex returns nil until BuildIndex inserts the finished index, so concurrent Search or watch-event calls for the same namespace/group/resource can both start builds. This duplicates work, can open the same file-backed bleve directory concurrently, and lets the last writer replace another live index in the cache without closing it. Add a per-key lock or reserve the key while building.

findings.title: TotalDocs iterates the index cache without locking
findings.body: bleveBackend.TotalDocs ranges over b.cache while BuildIndex may concurrently write to that map. TotalDocs does not take cacheMu.RLock, so this is an unsynchronized map read/write that can panic or return wrong totals. This is more likely now that BuildIndex only locks for the cache insertion.

findings.title: History and Origin dereference s.search without nil checks
findings.body: server.History calls s.search.History and server.Origin calls s.search.Origin, but s.search can be nil when search is not configured. server.Search checks for this case, while History and Origin will panic on a nil pointer if invoked. Add nil checks or return a not-configured error.

findings.title: Watch loop does not handle closed event channel
findings.body: The goroutine started in searchSupport.init receives from events with v := <-events and passes v to handleEvent. If the storage backend closes the channel, the receive returns a nil *WrittenEvent repeatedly, and handleEvent dereferences evt.Type, causing a panic. The loop also has no context.Done branch, so it cannot be stopped cleanly. Use v, ok := <-events and stop when !ok, and select on a cancellable context.

findings.title: IndexMetrics is used without nil checks in handleEvent
findings.body: handleEvent increments and decrements IndexMetrics.IndexedKinds for added and deleted events without checking whether IndexMetrics is nil. Other parts of the code guard with if IndexMetrics != nil. If metrics are not initialized, any ADDED or DELETED watch event will panic.

findings.title: BuildIndex uses IndexMetrics without nil check
findings.body: BuildIndex increments resource.IndexMetrics.IndexTenants unconditionally. Since other code paths check whether IndexMetrics is nil, this can panic when metrics are disabled or uninitialized. Guard the metric calls or guarantee initialization.

findings.title: Constructor leaks context/lifecycle resources when Init fails
findings.body: NewResourceServer creates a cancellable context and may run lifecycle initialization before s.Init. If s.Init returns an error, the constructor returns without calling cancel or stopping lifecycle hooks, leaking the context and any initialized backend resources. Clean up on the error path.

findings.title: Initial index build can miss events written before the watch starts
findings.body: searchSupport.init builds all indexes first and only then calls WatchWriteEvents. Writes that happen while the initial build is running are not included in the built index and are not replayed by the watcher, which starts after the build. In deployments with concurrent writers or other instances, the search index can remain stale until affected resources are written again.

findings.title: Postgres storage-server integration test is skipped
findings.body: The test now skips for GRAFANA_TEST_DB=postgres, so the storage server startup path is not exercised against Postgres in CI. Since this PR changes initialization timing and index building, this reduces coverage for a supported database; the skip should be tied to a tracked fix rather than left as an indefinite TODO.
